description: This file defines a class ScopeEntity within the OrangeHRM project, implementing OAuth2 scope entity functionality by using an interface and trait from the League OAuth2 server library. It encapsulates an identifier for OAuth scopes.

classes.name: ScopeEntity
classes.description: A class representing an OAuth2 scope entity, identifiable by a string identifier, implementing the ScopeEntityInterface, and using ScopeTrait for additional functionality.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ScopeEntity with a specific identifier.
